The 5-Alpha-Androstane-3-Beta,17beta-Diol, a metabolite of Umbelliferone, is a known target of LXR and is involved in the regulation of UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 2B4. This indicates a possible pathway where Umbelliferone influences LXR activity, which in turn modulates the expression of UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 2B4. The final score of 0.6656 suggests a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, supported by the sequential targeting of the entities in the provided graph. The evidence is consistent with a mechanistic link, but further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction and functional significance.
